title: Towards Explainable 3D Grounded Visual Question Answering: A New Benchmark and Strong Baseline

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance with and without 3D visual scenes (e.g., the 'QA w/o Scene' baseline) to measure reliance on dataset language priors, and assessing visual grounding accuracy to ensure answers are based on visual evidence rather than textual co-occurrences.
